subject: Clarify mid-cycle usage split + collection hold — Clearview Retail
messages:
From: Anika Shah <anika.shah@clearview.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Unexpected mid-cycle charge & collection hold

Hi Jonas,

We received an invoice this morning showing a substantial mid-cycle overage for January (see line item: usage tokens). Our finance team has placed a temporary collection hold until we can reconcile — they're asking for a breakdown of calls that drove the surge.

Two quick requests:
- Can you provide per-route sample logs (timestamped) for the period Jan 28–31? We need evidence to show these were live customer requests, not duplicates from staging.
- Also confirm whether the EU reverse-charge/VAT treatment should apply; our new EU entity was provisioned in December and we expected reverse-charge on Redwood invoices.

Attaching our internal snapshot for reference. Please advise next steps, as our payments team is requesting a point-of-contact for the hold.

Thanks,
Anika Shah
Head of Finance, Clearview Retail
attachments: clearview_usage_snapshot_20260131.csv

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Shah <anika.shah@clearview.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle charge & collection hold

Anika — thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. We're sorry for the surprise. Quick summary of next steps from our side:

1) I'll kick off a targeted export for Jan 28–31 per-route and per-requestid and share a sanitized sample set you can use for audit.
2) Marissa will review ledger attribution and confirm whether the usage was attributed to your production key or a staging key.
3) Ben will coordinate VAT/reverse-charge confirmation with our tax team and confirm whether invoices should have been net-of-VAT for your EU entity.

I can be your single point-of-contact on the hold — I'll escalate internally and come back with evidence within 48 hours.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | jonas@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Shah <anika.shah@clearview.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle charge & collection hold

Hi Anika — following up from ledger side.

Preliminary checks I ran this morning:
- We see a spike in token counts across two routes: /v1/gen-chat and /v1/embeddings/bulk between 2026-01-29 22:00 UTC and 2026-01-30 04:00 UTC.
- The traffic pattern shows repeated requests that share the same client-generated request_id (suggests retrying clients), but they are associated with your production API key (pk-live-xxx).
- I exported a 200-row sanitized sample and uploaded to the shared drive link (redacted customer PII). File: sanitized-sample-jan29.csv

Open questions we need your help on:
- Can your engineering team confirm whether those request_ids map to a legitimate batched ingestion job? If yes — was it expected to run in that timeframe?
- If these were staging replays, did they accidentally use the production key?

Attachments: ledger evidence snapshot; note that final reconciliation will need your sign-off if you want a retroactive credit.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Anika Shah <anika.shah@clearview.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Clearview Finance <billing@clearview.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 12:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle charge & collection hold

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. Quick internal check: our infra team confirms those request_ids are from an automated reindex job that ran during a contracted maintenance window, and it should have been routed through a staging key. It looks like the job was misconfigured and used the production key instead.

We're reviewing whether the run was partial (i.e., only a subset of shards retried) or replayed multiple times by the scheduler — I can share logs by tomorrow EOD.

Regarding VAT: we believe the invoice should be reverse-charge (we provided our EU VAT ID during onboarding). Please let Ben and his team know the EU entity details if they need documentation.

For the collection hold: we will lift if Redwood can provide a provisional credit for clearly duplicated replayed requests while we complete an internal post-mortem. Can you outline what evidence Redwood would need to consider a retroactive adjustment?

Regards,
Anika Shah
Head of Finance, Clearview Retail

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Shah <anika.shah@clearview.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ethan Price <ethan.price@stripe.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle charge & collection hold

Hi Anika — Ben from Finance here. Appreciate the quick confirmation on the misconfigured job. To make progress and lift the collection hold quickly, here's what we'll need from Clearview: 

Required from Clearview (to evaluate a provisional credit):
- A CSV mapping of the request_ids you confirm as "replayed/duplicated" (same IDs that Marissa's sample shows).
- Internal job run logs showing scheduler retries for the maintenance window (timestamps + shard ids).
- Confirmation in writing that these requests were not customer-facing (a short note from your infra lead is fine).

What Redwood will provide:
- We'll run a deduplication audit against our stored request footprint and provide a proposed credit schedule (token-level) with line-by-line evidence for the disputed tokens.
- We'll also validate the billing entity and apply the EU reverse-charge if your VAT ID on file matches. If we need a copy of the VAT certificate, please upload to the Drive link.

Timeline: if we receive your CSV + logs by end of day Monday (2026-02-16), we can produce a provisional credit estimate by Wednesday 2026-02-18 and aim to clear the collection hold once both sides sign off. If you prefer, we can also put a temporary invoice reissue (net-of-VAT) while this is resolved.

CC'ing Ethan at Stripe — if there are any payment reflow requirements on your side we can coordinate.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: signed-MPA-excerpt.pdf
